similarity.what: The player's building matches compared with the player's own held-back matches. This is the ceiling: how alike the player is to themselves.

still_share.meaning: share of alive time standing still

full_speed_share.meaning: share of alive time at running speed

slow_share.meaning: share of alive time moving slowly (walking or crouching)

mean_speed.meaning: average speed, game units per second

look_speed_deg_s.meaning: typical turning speed while moving, degrees per second

pitch_std.meaning: how much the view moves up and down

knife_out_share.meaning: share of alive time holding the knife

rifle_speed_at_first_shot.meaning: speed at the first rifle shot of a burst

moving_first_shot_share.meaning: share of rifle bursts started while still moving

single_shot_burst_share.meaning: share of bursts that are a single shot

crouched_shot_share.meaning: share of shots fired while crouched

turn_before_shot_deg.meaning: typical turn in the quarter second before a burst, degrees

peek_left_share.meaning: share of bursts started while strafing left

awp_shot_share.meaning: share of shots fired with the sniper rifle (AWP)

pistol_shot_share.meaning: share of shots fired with pistols

smoke_share.meaning: share of grenades that are smokes

flash_share.meaning: share of grenades that are flashbangs

fire_share.meaning: share of grenades that are fire grenades

first_contact_sec.meaning: typical seconds from round start to the first damage dealt or taken

opening_duel_rate.meaning: share of rounds where the player is in the first kill

team_distance.meaning: typical distance from the centre of the teammates, game units

alone_share.meaning: share of alive time more than 1200 units from the teammates' centre

jumps_per_min.applied_by: CloneDirector: presses jump at this rate while the bot runs outside a fight
jumps_per_min.status: implemented in the plugin; not run in CS2
